verdict.rationale: Migration credits are a fair pricing question for a cloud provider like Railway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no credit, discount, or incentive program for migrating workloads. The 'Migrate from Heroku' guide is migration documentation, an adjacent feature rather than credits, and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform
